question: Who among the following is the composer of Prayag Prashasti or the Allahabad Pillar in praise of Gupta ruler Samudra Gupta?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Harishena.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harishena** was a **4th-century Sanskrit poet.** 
 
• He was a **court poet** and minister in the Gupta emperor **Samudragupta.**
 
• He is the **composer of Prayag Prashasti or the Allahabad Pillar** in praise of Gupta ruler Samudragupta.
 
• He was also the author of several other inscriptions and** **literary works, including the Junagadh rock inscription of Skandagupta.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kalidasa** was a renowned Sanskrit poet and playwright, known for **works **such as **Shakuntala** and **Meghaduta.**
 
• **Vishakhadatta **was a playwright who wrote the famous **Sanskrit play Mudrarakshasa.**
 
• **Bhasa **was another famous Sanskrit playwright, known for **works **like **Svapnavasavadatta** and **Urubhanga.**

** Allahabad Pillar:**

 
• The **Allahabad Pillar** is a stambha that was **erected by Ashoka**, the Mauryan emperor who reigned in the** 3rd century BCE.**
 
• It is located at Prayagraj (Allahabad), Uttar Pradesh.
 
• It contains one of Ashoka's edicts.
 
• The** later inscriptions** attributed to the Gupta emperor **Samudragupta in the 4th Century CE **and the Mughal emperor **Jahangir in the 17th Century CE.**
